description: Check 1 to 20 identities against a dated active SAM snapshot. Pass identities as an array of objects, not a record ID or page URL. Each identity needs a name, UEI, CAGE, or NPI. Exact identifier matches and name-only possible matches remain distinct. Read coverage.freshness; stale or unknown-source empty lookups report unavailable with snapshot_status no_match_in_snapshot. No match is not clearance.

cage.description: Exact five-character CAGE code, when known.

name.description: Person or organization name; name-only matches are possible matches.

npi.description: Exact ten-digit National Provider Identifier, when known.

uei.description: Exact 12-character Unique Entity ID, when known.

generation.description: Retained snapshot UUID; omit for the current snapshot.

identities.description: One to twenty identities to compare with the dated SAM snapshot.

name: check_exclusions

freshness.description: Fresh, stale, unknown or unavailable, with age and the 24-hour warning policy.

observed_at.description: Observation time does not replace the official source timestamp.

status.description: Present as unavailable when no SAM coverage exists in this generation.

records.description: Candidate exclusion records with match basis; not a clearance decision.

snapshot_status.description: Observed lookup outcome in the dated snapshot, even when status is unavailable.

status.description:
Exact or possible match, fresh-snapshot no-match, or unavailable. Stale,
unknown and missing sources never produce a clean no-match status.

cage.description: Exact five-character CAGE code, when known.

name.description: Person or organization name; name-only matches are possible matches.

npi.description: Exact ten-digit National Provider Identifier, when known.

uei.description: Exact 12-character Unique Entity ID, when known.

JsonObject.description: Source-specific JSON map. The envelope is stable; map keys vary by official source.

evaluated_at.description: UTC time when age was evaluated; source and observation dates are unchanged.

max_age_seconds.description: Explicit warning threshold for this daily snapshot. Not a scheduler promise.

source_age_seconds.description: Age of the official source timestamp, never the import or enrichment timestamp.

warn_age_seconds.description: Early-warning boundary, separate from the stale-source boundary.

warning.description: User-facing warning, or null when within the warning threshold.

title: Check possible exclusion matches
